Full suite green: 517/517 passed. Two commits broke it. Both fixes are in `src`, no tests touched, and I haven't committed anything.

- **`958d3ae` (thousands separators in `formatMoney`)**: the cents part used `padEnd` instead of `padStart`, so 1 cent printed as `$0.10`. Fixed in `src/money.js`. The comma grouping stays.
- **`4188e9a` (per-line discount groundwork)**: `taxable` was set to `subtotal`, so order-level codes like SPRING10 were no longer taken off before tax. Now `taxable = subtotal - discount` in `src/invoice.js`. Line discounts are already in the subtotal, so they aren't subtracted twice. The `lineDiscounts` and `taxable` fields and the render row stay.

The other commits since the tag (`a356e59`, `2b3fe28`, `fe5f0e1`) didn't contribute to the failures.
